label: rare: early-step after q/3/z-initial prefix containing x/o, or copy step before q q
explanation: Extremely sparse (27 dev steps of 6.5M) and weak (max 0.14). Activations cluster in two loose groups: (a) original/delimiter steps t=3..7 in sequences starting with q, 3 or z whose prefix contains x or o (e.g. q e x [n], 3 e x [n], q c x x [<DEL>]); (b) copy steps outputting q or b right before a q q run (w b [b] q q). The best predicate covers ~70% of activations/mass but has precision <0.1%; tighter token-specific conjunctions just overfit the few examples (precision 8%, recall 33%). Magnitude is nearly constant (0.10-0.14) with no checked modulator. Does not fire at t<3 or on incorrect copies. No coherent description found.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by phase (copy phase: b, q; input phase: n, 0, l, h; delimiter step: ) and the token being output (most: q, z, b, 3, <DEL>, a; least: y, k, e, -); timing cues that raise it most: t=3, L=9 & t=12, L=8 & t=3.
